definition: Profit for the year after expenses and tax. It includes non-operating amounts shown in the accounts.
location: NSE audited consolidated Ind-AS filing, current year-to-date column, income rows and line 16. September filing, audited year-ended 31 March 2026 comparable column for the other income split.
notes: Total other income was ₹33.6926 crore. The audited annual column in the later filing identifies ₹16.2873 crore as an increase in the paper value of investments. Cupid reports Personal Care as one segment.
insight: Read profit alongside sales because the change in what investments were worth is counted in profit without adding to operating revenue.
